verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בָּ֣א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֥צַר עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šā·lō·wōš lə·mal·ḵūṯ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh bā nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel yə·rū·šā·lim way·yā·ṣar ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י בְּיָד֜וֹ אֶת־ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וּמִקְצָת֙ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיְבִיאֵ֥ם אֶֽרֶץ־ שִׁנְעָ֖ר בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְאֶת־ הַכֵּלִ֣ים הֵבִ֔יא בֵּ֖ית אוֹצַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’ă·ḏō·nāy bə·yā·ḏōw ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·miq·ṣāṯ kə·lê ḇêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ḇî·’êm ’e·reṣ- šin·‘ār bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·’eṯ- hak·kê·lîm hê·ḇî bêṯ ’ō·w·ṣar ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: And the Lord delivered into his hand Jehoiakim king of Judah along with some of the articles from the house of God He carried these off to the land of Shinar to the house of his god where he put them in the treasury of his god

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְאַשְׁפְּנַ֖ז רַ֣ב סָרִיסָ֑יו לְהָבִ֞יא מִבְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּמִזֶּ֥רַע הַמְּלוּכָ֖ה וּמִן־ הַֽפַּרְתְּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ lə·’aš·pə·naz raḇ sā·rî·sāw lə·hā·ḇî mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·miz·ze·ra‘ ham·mə·lū·ḵāh ū·min- hap·par·tə·mîm
verses.literal: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz the chief of his court officials to bring in some Israelites . . . from the royal family and the nobility

verses.original: יְלָדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־ בָּהֶ֣ם כָּל־ מְאוּם וְטוֹבֵ֨י מַרְאֶ֜ה וּמַשְׂכִּילִ֣ים בְּכָל־ חָכְמָ֗ה וְיֹ֤דְעֵי דַ֙עַת֙ וּמְבִינֵ֣י מַדָּ֔ע וַאֲשֶׁר֙ כֹּ֣חַ בָּהֶ֔ם לַעֲמֹ֖ד בְּהֵיכַ֣ל הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּֽלֲלַמְּדָ֥ם סֵ֖פֶר וּלְשׁ֥וֹן כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yə·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer ’ên- bā·hem kāl- mə·ʾūm wə·ṭō·w·ḇê mar·’eh ū·maś·kî·lîm bə·ḵāl ḥāḵ·māh wə·yō·ḏə·‘ê ḏa·‘aṯ ū·mə·ḇî·nê mad·dā‘ wa·’ă·šer kō·aḥ bā·hem la·‘ă·mōḏ bə·hê·ḵal ham·me·leḵ ū·lă·lam·mə·ḏām sê·p̄er ū·lə·šō·wn kaś·dîm
verses.literal: young men without blemish handsome . . . gifted in all wisdom knowledgeable . . . quick to understand and qualified to serve in the king’s palace and to teach them the language and literature of the Chaldeans

verses.original: וַיְמַן֩ לָהֶ֨ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ דְּבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֗וֹ מִפַּת־ בַּ֤ג הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וּמִיֵּ֣ין מִשְׁתָּ֔יו וּֽלְגַדְּלָ֖ם שָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ וּמִ֨קְצָתָ֔ם יַֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·man lā·hem ham·me·leḵ də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw mip·paṯ- baḡ ham·me·leḵ ū·mî·yên miš·tāw ū·lə·ḡad·də·lām šā·nîm šā·lō·wōš ū·miq·ṣā·ṯām ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: The king assigned them daily provisions of the royal food and wine . . . They were to be trained for three years after which they were to enter . . . the king’s service

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם מִבְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה דָּנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇā·hem mib·bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh dā·nî·yêl ḥă·nan·yāh mî·šā·’êl wa·‘ă·zar·yāh
verses.literal: Among these young men were some from Judah Daniel Hananiah Mishael and Azariah

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם לָהֶ֛ם שַׂ֥ר הַסָּרִיסִ֖ים שֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיָּ֨שֶׂם לְדָֽנִיֵּ֜אל בֵּ֣לְטְשַׁאצַּ֗ר וְלַֽחֲנַנְיָה֙ שַׁדְרַ֔ךְ וּלְמִֽישָׁאֵ֣ל מֵישַׁ֔ךְ וְלַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה עֲבֵ֥ד נְגֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem lā·hem śar has·sā·rî·sîm šê·mō·wṯ way·yā·śem lə·ḏā·nî·yêl bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar wə·la·ḥă·nan·yāh šaḏ·raḵ ū·lə·mî·šā·’êl mê·šaḵ wə·la·‘ă·zar·yāh ‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw
verses.literal: The chief official gave them . . . new names To Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar to Hananiah Shadrach to Mishael Meshach and to Azariah Abednego

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּנִיֵּאל֙ עַל־ לִבּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִתְגָּאַ֛ל בְּפַתְבַּ֥ג הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבְיֵ֣ין מִשְׁתָּ֑יו וַיְבַקֵּשׁ֙ מִשַּׂ֣ר הַסָּרִיסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א יִתְגָּאָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem dā·nî·yêl ‘al- lib·bōw ’ă·šer lō- yiṯ·gā·’al bə·p̄aṯ·baḡ ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇə·yên miš·tāw way·ḇaq·qêš miś·śar has·sā·rî·sîm ’ă·šer lō yiṯ·gā·’āl
verses.literal: But Daniel made up his mind that he would not defile himself with the king’s food or wine . . . So he asked the chief official for permission not to defile himself

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ דָּ֣נִיֵּ֔אל לְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽלְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִפְנֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר הַסָּרִיסִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- dā·nî·yêl lə·ḥe·seḏ ū·lə·ra·ḥă·mîm lip̄·nê śar has·sā·rî·sîm
verses.literal: Now God had granted Daniel favor and compassion from the chief official

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר שַׂ֤ר הַסָּרִיסִים֙ לְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל יָרֵ֤א אֲנִי֙ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִנָּ֔ה אֶת־ מַאֲכַלְכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ מִשְׁתֵּיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֡ר לָמָּה֩ יִרְאֶ֨ה אֶת־ פְּנֵיכֶ֜ם זֹֽעֲפִ֗ים מִן־ הַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּגִֽילְכֶ֔ם וְחִיַּבְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ רֹאשִׁ֖י לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer śar has·sā·rî·sîm lə·ḏā·nî·yêl yā·rê ’ă·nî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer min·nāh ’eṯ- ma·’ă·ḵal·ḵem wə·’eṯ- miš·tê·ḵem ’ă·šer lām·māh yir·’eh ’eṯ- pə·nê·ḵem zō·‘ă·p̄îm min- hay·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer kə·ḡî·lə·ḵem wə·ḥî·yaḇ·tem ’eṯ- rō·šî lam·me·leḵ
verses.literal: but he . . . said to Daniel I fear my lord the king who has assigned your food and drink For why should he see your faces looking thinner than those of the other young men your age You would endanger my head before the king

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּנִיֵּ֖אל אֶל־ הַמֶּלְצַ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִנָּה֙ שַׂ֣ר הַסָּֽרִיסִ֔ים עַל־ דָּנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·nî·yêl ’el- ham·mel·ṣar ’ă·šer min·nāh śar has·sā·rî·sîm ‘al- dā·nî·yêl ḥă·nan·yāh mî·šā·’êl wa·‘ă·zar·yāh
verses.literal: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel Hananiah Mishael and Azariah

verses.original: נַס־ נָ֥א אֶת־ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וְיִתְּנוּ־ לָ֜נוּ מִן־ הַזֵּרֹעִ֛ים וְנֹאכְלָ֖ה וּמַ֥יִם וְנִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nas- nā ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā yā·mîm ‘ă·śā·rāh wə·yit·tə·nū- lā·nū min- haz·zê·rō·‘îm wə·nō·ḵə·lāh ū·ma·yim wə·niš·teh
verses.literal: Please test your servants for ten days Let us be given only vegetables to eat and water to drink

verses.original: וְיֵרָא֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ מַרְאֵ֔ינוּ וּמַרְאֵה֙ הַיְלָדִ֔ים הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת פַּתְבַּ֣ג הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְאֵ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם־ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·rā·’ū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā mar·’ê·nū ū·mar·’êh hay·lā·ḏîm hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm ’êṯ paṯ·baḡ ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵa·’ă·šer tir·’êh ‘ă·śêh ‘im- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then compare . . . our appearances with those of the young men who are eating the royal food and deal with your servants according to what you see

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע לָהֶ֖ם לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיְנַסֵּ֖ם יָמִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ lā·hem lad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh way·nas·sêm yā·mîm ‘ă·śā·rāh
verses.literal: So he consented to this and tested them for ten days

verses.original: וּמִקְצָת֙ יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֔ה נִרְאָ֤ה מַרְאֵיהֶם֙ ט֔וֹב וּבְרִיאֵ֖י בָּשָׂ֑ר מִן־ כָּל־ הַיְלָדִ֔ים הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת פַּתְבַּ֥ג הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·ṣāṯ yā·mîm ‘ă·śā·rāh nir·’āh mar·’ê·hem ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇə·rî·’ê bā·śār min- kāl- hay·lā·ḏîm hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm ’êṯ paṯ·baḡ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And at the end of ten days they looked . . . healthier and better nourished . . . than all the young men who were eating the king’s food

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַמֶּלְצַ֗ר נֹשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ פַּתְבָּגָ֔ם וְיֵ֖ין מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְנֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם זֵרְעֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·mel·ṣar nō·śê ’eṯ- paṯ·bā·ḡām wə·yên miš·tê·hem wə·nō·ṯên lā·hem zê·rə·‘ō·nîm
verses.literal: So the steward continued to withhold their choice food and the wine they were to drink and he gave them vegetables instead

verses.original: וְהַיְלָדִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אַרְבַּעְתָּ֔ם נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֧ם הָֽאֱלֹהִ֛ים מַדָּ֥ע וְהַשְׂכֵּ֖ל בְּכָל־ סֵ֣פֶר וְחָכְמָ֑ה וְדָנִיֵּ֣אל הֵבִ֔ין בְּכָל־ חָז֖וֹן וַחֲלֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·lā·ḏîm hā·’êl·leh ’ar·ba‘·tām nā·ṯan lā·hem hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mad·dā‘ wə·haś·kêl bə·ḵāl sê·p̄er wə·ḥā·ḵə·māh wə·ḏā·nî·yêl hê·ḇîn bə·ḵāl ḥā·zō·wn wa·ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding in every kind of literature and wisdom And Daniel had insight into all kinds of visions and dreams

verses.original: וּלְמִקְצָת֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ אָמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לַהֲבִיאָ֑ם וַיְבִיאֵם֙ שַׂ֣ר הַסָּרִיסִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·miq·ṣāṯ hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ la·hă·ḇî·’ām way·ḇî·’êm śar has·sā·rî·sîm lip̄·nê nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar
verses.literal: Now at the end of the time specified by the king the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתָּם֮ הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְלֹ֤א נִמְצָא֙ מִכֻּלָּ֔ם כְּדָנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַרְיָ֑ה וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’it·tām ham·me·leḵ wə·lō nim·ṣā mik·kul·lām kə·ḏā·nî·yêl ḥă·nan·yāh mî·šā·’êl wa·‘ă·zar·yāh way·ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And the king spoke with them and among all the young men he found no one equal to Daniel Hananiah Mishael and Azariah So they entered . . . the king’s service

verses.original: וְכֹ֗ל דְּבַר֙ חָכְמַ֣ת בִּינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ בִּקֵּ֥שׁ מֵהֶ֖ם הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽיִּמְצָאֵ֞ם עֶ֣שֶׂר יָד֗וֹת עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים֙ הָֽאַשָּׁפִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּכָל־ מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl də·ḇar ḥā·ḵə·maṯ bî·nāh ’ă·šer- biq·qêš mê·hem ham·me·leḵ way·yim·ṣā·’êm ‘e·śer yā·ḏō·wṯ ‘al kāl- ha·ḥar·ṭum·mîm hā·’aš·šā·p̄îm ’ă·šer bə·ḵāl mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king consulted them he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל עַד־ שְׁנַ֥ת אַחַ֖ת לְכ֥וֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî dā·nî·yêl ‘aḏ- šə·naṯ ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḵō·w·reš ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And Daniel remained there until the first year of King Cyrus
